# Astronomical 0.2.62
## What's new
- `astronomical respond` adds `--text`, `--instructions`, and `--thinking-budget` controls. - REST structured-output requests now receive the schema-derived instruction alongside JSON Schema enforcement, matching the CLI behavior. - Qwen3.5 A3B uses a fused Metal GDN decode-prework kernel on eligible bf16 workers; other configurations retain the composed implementation. - The retired draft-assisted prefill feature is removed. Dense full-prompt processing, persistent prompt caching, and native multi-token prediction remain.
## Compatibility
Startup removes obsolete settings and feature-specific cache artifacts from the retired prefill feature. Model files, unrelated user settings, and the remaining prompt-cache behavior are preserved.
## Distribution
The macOS disk image is Developer ID signed and notarized, and the Sparkle update feed is signed.
